notes: A Status box at the top of The job, so you can set where a job has got to instead of only having it worked out for you. It starts on automatic and tells you what that works out to; pick one and it stands until you clear it. Cancelled is now one of the choices, and a real one: a job that was called off used to read as Wrapped up next to the ones you actually delivered, and it still asked you to raise an invoice for a night that never happened. It now says Cancelled, files with the past, and goes quiet. Dark mode is black rather than dark blue - true black behind the app, near-black panels and neutral greys throughout, with the blue kept only for the accent. Every text colour was checked against its background for contrast first.
